operating_notes.text: Converted ₹450 Cr inter-corporate deposits into 10-year OFCDs at 1% coupon issued by wholly owned subsidiary Heranba Organics Private Limited.
NCLT dismissed Section 9 IBC application against subsidiary Heranba Organics as principal debt fell below Section 4 thresholds.
Other income for Q4FY26 was negative due to foreign exchange losses.

timeline.summary: Heranba Industries approved converting ₹450 Cr inter-corporate deposits to subsidiary Heranba Organics into 10-year OFCDs.
NCLT dismissed the Section 9 IBC insolvency application filed by Haresh Petrochem against Heranba Industries subsidiary Heranba Organics.
Raghuram K Shetty, Promoter of Heranba Industries Limited, confirmed no promoter or promoter group encumbrance on shares during FY2025-26 as of April 06, 2026.
Heranba Industries secured shareholder approval via postal ballot on May 21, 2026, for the appointment of two directors.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹319.48 Cr (-4.6% YoY), net loss to shareholders ₹57.82 Cr (against a loss of ₹41.49 Cr a year earlier).
Raghuram K Shetty, Promoter of Heranba Industries Limited, confirmed no promoter or promoter group encumbrance on shares during FY2025-26 as of April 06, 2026.
Heranba Industries informed the exchange regarding the resignation of CFO Pravin Shetty effective December 31, 2026.
